latest.name: PixVerse AI (V6)
latest.developer: PixVerse (web service operated by AIVORA PTE. LTD.; Google Play publisher: MOTIVAI PRIVATE LIMITED)
latest.short_verdict: A capable all-in-one text/image-to-video and editing workspace with 60 initial plus 30 daily free credits. The free plan is limited to 540p, two concurrent generations, no watermark-free export, and non-commercial use.
latest.what_it_does: PixVerse is a browser and Android AI creative studio for text-to-video and image-to-video generation. It also offers templates and effects, video editing, motion control, transitions, video extension, reference-guided generation, AI avatars and lip-sync, music-video creation, and sound effects. Feature and model availability can vary by plan, app version, and region.
latest.why_try_it: It is useful for turning a still image into a short moving scene, prototyping social clips, trying templates, and extending or refining generated footage without moving between several apps. Independent blind-preference data exists for its current V6 video model, making it a credible candidate to test, though the free tier is for experimentation rather than commercial delivery.
latest.free_tier: Basic plan: US$0, 60 initial credits and 30 daily credits. Daily credits reset at 00:00 UTC and expire at the end of that UTC day if unused. Basic supports video output up to 540p and up to two concurrent generations. Credits are the usage currency; the number consumed depends on model, resolution, duration, audio and other settings, so the published allowance does not translate into a guaranteed number of videos.
latest.limits: The Basic plan does not list watermark-free export; watermark-free downloads are presented as a paid-plan benefit. Free outputs are limited to non-commercial use under PixVerse's Terms. Daily credits expire rather than accumulating. Generation costs vary and are shown in the creation interface; regenerating uses credits again, while failed generations are described in the FAQ as automatically refunded. The Terms say submitted/generated information content may be used in aggregated and anonymized form to improve the service, including model training, unless an opt-out is made available. Third-party models have their own usage rules.
latest.signup_pakistan: No Pakistan-specific exclusion was found in the public Terms checked on 2026-11-10. The Terms say the service can be accessed from anywhere, while warning that features and products may vary by country or region. The public registration page offers email-and-password signup. A Pakistan-based signup, regional model availability, and acceptance of Pakistan-issued payment cards were not independently tested; paid checkout acceptance in Pakistan remains unverified.
latest.quality_evidence: Independent evidence: Artificial Analysis's AA-Video-T2V v2.1 blind-preference leaderboard listed PixVerse V6 at #23, Elo 981±15 (95% interval 966–996), from 4,493 samples, when checked 2026-11-10. This is text-to-video preference data, not a guarantee for every feature or prompt. Vendor-reported adoption: PixVerse stated on 2026-03-12 that it had passed 100M users across 175 countries, generated 2.1B videos and had 16M monthly active users; these are company claims, not an independent audit. Google Play showed 50M+ installs, 4.5 stars and approximately 4.55M reviews. Anecdotal community feedback: one Reddit user reported image-to-video was more consistent than text-only generation, while noting prompt sensitivity and occasional distortions; this is an individual account, not representative testing.
latest.android_status: Verified official Google Play listing: PixVerse: AI Video Generator, package com.pixverseai.pixverse. The listing showed 50M+ downloads, 4.5 stars and about 4.55M reviews when checked. It describes V6 text/image-to-video, editing, motion control, video extension, avatars and audio tools. Google Play identifies MOTIVAI PRIVATE LIMITED as the publisher; PixVerse's web Terms identify AIVORA PTE. LTD. as the service operator. Pakistan-specific Play Store install availability was not independently confirmed.
